browser_review.method: The console and the hosted page were served by a throwaway Node server outside the repository. It reads the real assets from the working tree on every request, sends the response policies of server.rs and bridge.rs (minus HSTS) and answers the API from synthetic data shaped from the service serializers. Its 20 console routes equal the static routes of server.rs. The catalog and the report are the rendered files above, served from a local static server. Every count below is from the final asset bytes.
browser_review.bound: Synthetic data and one headless Chromium. Not the kiln-web-service or kiln-hosted executables, not a deployment, not Firefox or Safari, not a touch device and not a screen reader

Contrast is computed from resolved colours on flat backgrounds; text over a gradient is measured against the nearest solid layer
Passing declared-reference coverage under the development profile is linkage, not acceptance of the requirements
